Package it.polimi.ingsw.view.cli

Class SetupCLI

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.cli.AbstractCLI
it.polimi.ingsw.view.cli.SetupCLI
All Implemented Interfaces:
ReconnectableView, SetupView
public class SetupCLI extends AbstractCLI implements SetupView
Class used when the client chooses to play the TUI version of the game; this class represents the CLI for the player reception phase, before entering an actual game.

    • showJoinGameDialog

      public void showJoinGameDialog(List<Content> colors, int gameId)
      Handles the second step of the player's reception: it makes the player choose a color from those available in the game he's trying to join, then it asks the player to choose his nickname. This method is used also with a player that just created a new game.
      Specified by:
      showJoinGameDialog in interface SetupView
      Parameters:
      colors - the list of a match's available colors.
      gameId - the id of the game the player is trying to join.
      See Also:
      • Content

      Parameters:
